title: Hub skills
empty: No skills match. Change the search term or folder.
error: Could not read or save the content. Try again.
consent: I have read the instructions and files and agree to install them in the project.
runNotice: After installation the AI agent can use the files and code according to the instructions.

installState.installed: The same revision is already installed. No files will change.
installState.missing: Installs a new skill in the project.
installState.other-revision: Replaces the project’s existing revision with the selected revision.
installState.edited: Edited project skills are not overwritten. Keep your changes separately and try again.
installState.conflict: Another skill has the same name. Rename the project skill and try again.
installState.suspended: Suspended revisions cannot be installed. Check another revision.

authorOnly: Only the registrant can see this because shareable licence terms have not been identified.
findingsNone: No places were flagged automatically. This does not replace a person’s review.
findingsHint: Automatically flagged text. Read it in the surrounding file context.
unused: No registered Workflow uses this yet.
projectReason: Inspect the exact files used in your project.
taken: Another registrant owns this name. Rename it in your project before registering.
sameTree: The content matches the latest revision, so a new revision cannot be registered.
blocked: This content cannot be registered. Check the source instructions and name.
registerNote: Describe why you are registering or what changed in one line.
noSourceSkills: No skills are available here. Choose another source.
suspended: This revision is suspended. New installs and Workflow use are blocked.
projectOnly: Hub skills install into a project. Change the scope to project.
unchanged: {name} revision {revision} is already installed. No files were changed.
